verdict.rationale: Brave Search API has no native scheduling or background-automation feature of its own. It can only be wired into autonomous workflows through third-party platforms, which Brave documents in official guides: an official community node for the n8n automation platform, and integrations with Dify agent orchestration and OpenClaw agents. Missing for 10: native scheduled or recurring jobs, a background execution or trigger mechanism within the product, any documentation of autonomous runs without an external orchestrator, and hands-on corroboration.
